description: 条件項目と水準・無効組合せ・ルールから全組合せを決定的に列挙し、無効組合せの除外・同一動作列の圧縮(don't care導出)・条件組合せ被覆・動作未定義組合せの検出・圧縮前後の列数と削減率をMarkdownで返す。圧縮後ルールは DT: プレフィックスの網羅対象IDとして generate_test_cases の decisionTable へそのまま渡せる。analyze_cause_effect の「5. デシジョンテーブルへの引き渡し」の条件項目・動作項目を、水準を ["T","F"] として投入することもできる。

id.description: Action id, unique within the table, e.g. A1

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

id.description: Condition id, unique within the table, e.g. C1

levels.description: Possible levels for this condition; 2 or more expected

sourceFactorId.description: Source factor id from factorInventory (e.g. FCT-01); enables the factor handover check

factorInventory.description: Factor table declared in the factor decomposition frame; enables the factor handover check

categoryKey.description: Factor category key (signal/noise/state/control); validated against testcondition://factor/ralph-frame

droppedReason.description: Why this factor is not handed over to any technique

fixedCondition.description: Whether this factor was separated as a fixed condition

handoverTargetIds.description: Handover targets (FHO-01..FHO-04 or the target tool name)

id.description: Factor id from the factor table, e.g. FCT-01

levels.description: Levels declared in the factor table

name.description: Factor name as written in the factor table

invalidCombinations.description: Combinations that can never occur, excluded before rule matching

rules.description: Rules mapping condition selectors to actions; unspecified action ids default to N

tableId.description: Table id used to build coverage target ids (default MAIN)

testBasisDocuments.description: Test basis documents used to verify that declared labels (factor names, level values, state names, etc.), quoted wordings and referenced ids really exist in the test basis. Pass the full text: passing only excerpts makes existing wordings be reported as ungrounded. When omitted, the grounding check is reported as not inspectable instead of passing silently.

content.description: Full text of the document (any format; caller converts binaries to text)

name.description: Document name or file name of the test basis document

name: design_decision_table
title: Design Decision Table
